query: SELECT 'group' AS object_type, "group".id, "group".name AS label FROM "group" WHERE location_id = ?1 UNION ALL SELECT 'item', item.id, item.name FROM item_location JOIN item ON item.id = item_location.item_id WHERE item_location.location_id = ?1 UNION ALL SELECT 'connection', connection.id, connection.name FROM connection WHERE connection.from_location_id = ?1 OR connection.to_location_id = ?1 ORDER BY object_type, id
